## Known Limitations

* Real Firebase reads/writes are entirely stubbed/mocked away, as requested, to avoid touching production data.
* Full UI E2E testing (like Cypress) isn't implemented to avoid fragile selectors on frozen V1 UI. Instead, we use `@testing-library/react` focused on critical usability classes.
* We cannot test actual split logic `processAssetSplit` because it relies heavily on direct Firebase state management which is tightly coupled to the component logic (not exposed as pure service methods).
* We avoided changing production code to fix the internal `REVERSAL` conservation logic issue (subtracting original quantity instead of multiplying by -1) in `calculateAssetInventory`, so tests reflect the actual deployed application state.
